# Proqi 0.10.0

Proqi 0.10.0 adds contextual undo and redo, a focused Commands workflow,
verified installation across more Unix targets, and resilient session
continuity.

## Highlights

- Undo and redo now follow the active owner across Compose, thought editing,
  Board operations, editable queries, rename fields, and session Browser
  administration. Board, Editor, and Browser history survives restart, while
  temporary query history ends when its field closes. On macOS, `Ctrl+Z`,
  `Ctrl+Shift+Z`, and `Ctrl+Y` provide terminal-safe aliases alongside the
  configurable Primary bindings and Board `u`.
- Commands opens with a short `Relevant now` list for the current context.
  Choose `More commands...` for the categorized inventory, or type immediately
  to search all 57 commands with deterministic Unicode-aware ranking. Commands
  that are currently unavailable remain visible with a reason and cannot run.
- Install without a package manager through one checksum-verifying script.
  Release archives now cover Apple silicon and Intel macOS, plus x86-64 and
  ARM64 Linux with GNU or static musl builds. Debian packages cover `amd64` and
  `arm64`; Homebrew remains the recommended macOS installation.
- Verified standalone installations can update and restart from inside Proqi.
  Homebrew and standalone schema-changing updates quiesce active work, migrate
  once, and restore every participating process by its exact session identity,
  state root, working directory, process lineage, and inherited terminal.
- When the terminal watchdog confirms that the input lane has stopped while
  the pane remains usable, an active Board, Compose, or Edit session can replace
  itself once and resume in the same pane. Recovery is exact-session scoped and
  circuit-broken to prevent restart loops.
- On macOS, `Ctrl+Enter` submits and removes while `Ctrl+Shift+Enter` submits and
  keeps. Plain Enter remains newline and smart-list continuation. Primary
  submission aliases remain configurable.
- Set `mouse_capture = false` when a terminal or multiplexer should retain mouse
  reporting ownership. Proqi omits its mouse-capture handshake; mouse actions
  still require the outer terminal stack to deliver mouse events.
- Wrapped visual-row end movement now keeps the caret on the intended row at a
  shared soft-wrap boundary. `New thought` also keeps a genuinely empty board
  provisional and uses the live board tail for explicit final-row insertion.

## Install

Homebrew is recommended on macOS:

```shell
brew install oborchers/tap/proqi
```

On Linux, or on macOS without Homebrew:

```shell
curl -LsSf https://github.com/oborchers/proqi/releases/latest/download/proqi-installer.sh | sh
```

The standalone installer verifies the selected archive and installs into
`$HOME/.local/bin` by default without `sudo` or a `PATH` change. Rust 1.88 or
newer remains supported through `cargo install proqi --locked`.

## Compatibility

Existing stores migrate automatically from schema 15 and storage protocol 14
to schema 16 and storage protocol 15 for durable Browser administration
history. Older Proqi binaries cannot open an upgraded store.

Standalone self-update requires the installation marker included in verified
release archives. Debian, Cargo, and source-owned installations remain
non-mutating and receive installation-specific update instructions.

## Known limitations

Undo restores only local Proqi state. It does not recall delivered prompts,
destination copies, clipboard writes, exports, installed updates, or external
file changes. Permanent session pruning remains irreversible.

A revoked or unusable PTY cannot be repaired by replacing Proqi. Automatic
input recovery is limited to two attempts per exact session in a rolling
ten-minute window; an unrecoverable or repeated stall exits with the exact
manual resume command.
